en.title: Soft Delete Is More Than an IsDeleted Flag: Global Query Filters in EF Core
en.subtitle: A query filter only hides rows from LINQ reads. Cascades, unique indexes, required navigations, bulk deletes and IgnoreQueryFilters all still need a decision.
